title: Nested architecture workshop
principle: Recipes compose existing local operators. These examples are starting points, not a closed list of shapes.

examples.title: A temple, built from shared parts.

workflow: Read this compact index, then only the recipes or scene details needed. Bind supports and paths to the current scene, estimate, apply, inspect and observe. Composition source is authoring data: first load authored geometry without generated instances, build the declared assemblies, then estimate/apply the recipe instances and capture before exporting. Downloadable .scene files already include those paths. Preserve user edits; do not clear their scene.
